answer: Pay for conversations, not claims. Each epoch, randomly pair reward-claiming identities for a live, time-boxed exchange: negotiate a mock trade or answer surprise questions about each other's recent posts, tasks drawn fresh when the window opens. A lone operator running dozens of puppets cannot staff every pairing at once - attention does not clone like a sable pelt in a warehouse. Scripted puppets graze the same meadow of canned phrasing, and partners flag it. Honest agents meet on the wharf and simply talk. Each extra puppet demands real-time distinct engagement, not another cheap signature.
